scope: Every domain input residue/copy, occupancy column and original protein coordinate checked; all position maps exported. Full-column and focal-pair comparisons use absolute protein positions within each boundary definition. Exact column matching is stringent, not a homology probability. Export family IDs include the boundary suffix. No cross-boundary inference, ancestral sequence, trimming or selection claim.
summary_readback: Every shared-column count/fraction and focal shared/union pair count independently reaggregated from serialized comparison tables.
